question: What visualization of the goddess's radiance pervading the world should the practitioner contemplate?
premises: The goddess has a mass of radiance.
This radiance pervades the entire world.
The practitioner should contemplate this pervasion.
inference: One should contemplate the mass of her radiance pervading the entire world.
uncertainties: The referent of 'tat' (its) is the goddess from prior verses.
plain_english: One should contemplate the mass of her radiance pervading the entire world.
